boundary.latency_scope: ORT controller only, server CPU; excludes encoding, memory, rendering, shell and teacher
boundary.pointer_closure_scope: candidate/memory IDs, availability, role, uniqueness and budget; full rendered citation closure is not measured
boundary.risk_coverage_scope: eligible nonempty local proposals; grouped confidence ties; truncated reachable-coverage AURC
boundary.support_scope: available assessed candidates only; masked and not_assessed excluded

intervention.boundary: count-change sign including zero; not paired directional training loss or full-graph intervention
